title: Three checks before money moves out
objectives: Name the three checks before any redemption, switch, STP or SWP.
Explain why each instalment's date matters at exit.
body_md:
Before any redemption, switch, STP or SWP, run three checks.

## 1. Exit load

Recent SIP instalments may still be inside the exit-load period, even in a SIP that started years ago. Check the scheme's terms, instalment by instalment.

## 2. Tax

Every switch, STP transfer and SWP withdrawal is a redemption, so gains on it may be taxed. Ask the client to check with a CA. Never give tax advice, and never call a withdrawal tax-free.

## 3. Details

Confirm the nominee, bank account and KYC are current before money starts flowing out. Money leaving is the worst time to discover a closed bank account.

## FIFO, again

Units are redeemed oldest first, so each instalment's own purchase date decides its exit load and tax treatment. That is why a plan built on "the SIP is old" can still produce a charge.
example: A client switches ₹6 lakh from equity to a liquid fund. The check finds that the last year's instalments carry a 1% exit load, so the switch is split: part now, part after the load period ends.
say: Let's check the exit load on the recent instalments, and confirm your nominee and bank details.
The tax on this redemption is a question for your CA; I'll flag which instalments are involved.
never: Switching between funds is not a redemption, so there's no tax.
Your KYC will be fine; it was done years ago.

talk_track.title: Three checks before money moves out
talk_track.text: Before any money moves out, whether by redemption, switch, STP or SWP, run three checks. Exit load: recent SIP instalments may still be inside the exit-load period, even in a SIP that started years ago. Tax: every switch, STP transfer and SWP withdrawal is a redemption, so gains on it may be taxed; ask the client to check with a CA. Details: confirm the nominee, bank account and KYC are up to date before money starts flowing out.

check.q: Which three checks come before a redemption, switch, STP or SWP?
o: Exit load, tax, and nominee/bank/KYC details
The fund manager's tenure, the AUM and the star rating
The AMC's office address and the folio number
check.why: Exit load per instalment, the tax position (referred to a CA), and current nominee, bank and KYC details.

check.q: Why is a switch between schemes a tax event?
o: Because the AMC charges a fee
Because it is a redemption of units, so gains on it may be taxed
Because SEBI treats switches as sales of the AMC
It is not a tax event
check.why: A switch, an STP transfer and an SWP withdrawal are all redemptions. Gains may be taxable; refer the client to a CA.

check.q: What does FIFO mean at redemption?
o: The newest units are sold first
The oldest units are treated as sold first
Units are sold in equal parts
The AMC decides which units to sell
check.why: First in, first out: the oldest units are redeemed first, so each instalment's own date decides its exit load and tax.
